dialogues.speaker: Melies
dialogues.text: Oh hey there, my dearest partner! Are you here to shoot a Flash Cut?

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Of course! Now that we've shown Flash Cuts to be a viable enterprise and have a future path, the future is bright, bright, bright!

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Both the short-drama format of Flash Cuts and the ad-style Flash Cuts that was just proposed have the potential to take Fontaine by storm.

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Now, all we need to do is take the plunge! We're set to become the biggest stars in all of Fontaine, no, the entire world.

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: And when that happens, we'll never have to worry about running out of Mora again... the crazy special effects no one wouldn't have touched before, the six-hour-long experimental films... There's light at the end of the tunnel now!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Just make sure you don't spend all your money in one go...

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Oh, don't you worry about that! As Fontaine's most talented director, I can assure you my project management skills are equally top-notch. You can expect to hear good news from us!

choices.text: I'll leave you to it, then.

response.speaker: Melies
response.text: Bye! You can come by anytime. Maybe we'll have even better news for you the next time we see you!
